🔑 <b>مرحله ۱ از ۳ | ساخت API Token</b>\n.en: 🔑 Step 1 of 3 | Create an API Token 1. Open the Cloudflare dashboard. 2. Go to My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token. 3. Choose Edit zone DNS or Custom Token. 4. For zone listing, grant Zone → Zone → Read; for DNS changes, Zone → DNS → Edit. 5. Under Zone Resources, select only the required zones. 6. Copy the token when it is generated. Additional features require corresponding permissions, such as Zone Settings Edit and Cache Purge.

Скопируйте созданный токен. Другим функциям могут понадобиться дополнительные права, например Zone Settings Edit и Cache Purge.
